question: Which of the following compounds will give racemic mixture on nucleophilic substitution with OH<sup>-</sup>?
explanation: 2-chlorobutane is chiral and undergoes substitution via a carbocation intermediate (S<sub>N</sub>1) leading to racemization.

question: The dipole moment is lowest for which of the following molecules?
explanation: Although fluorine is most electronegative, the C-I bond has a smaller dipole moment due to the very long bond length despite lower electronegativity difference compared to C-F.

question: Which alkyl halide reacts most rapidly by an S<sub>N</sub>2 mechanism?
explanation: S<sub>N</sub>2 rate decreases with steric hindrance. Methyl chloride (CH<sub>3</sub>-Cl) has minimal steric hindrance, reacting fastest.

question: In the reaction CH<sub>3</sub>CH<sub>2</sub>Br + NaCN → CH<sub>3</sub>CH<sub>2</sub>CN + NaBr, the nucleophile is:
explanation: Cyanide ion (CN<sup>-</sup>) acts as an ambident nucleophile attacking the electrophilic carbon of ethyl bromide.

question: Which reagent converts primary alcohols to alkyl chlorides without carbocation rearrangement?
explanation: SOCl<sub>2</sub> in pyridine proceeds via an internal nucleophilic substitution (S<sub>N</sub>i) mechanism without carbocation formation.
